The vendor directly providing the **Salesforce** platform at **salesforce.com** is **Salesforce, Inc.** (historically **salesforce.com, inc.**).

### Evidence
According to the official **Salesforce Privacy Statement** at `salesforce.com`:
> *"Salesforce, Inc. and/or its affiliated entities (“Salesforce”, “we”, “us”, or the “Company”) are responsible for the processing of your Personal Data as described in this Privacy Statement, unless specified otherwise, and act as the controller of such Personal Data."*

Additional official legal documents identify the entity as:
> *"salesforce.com, inc., a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at Salesforce Tower, 415 Mission Street, 3rd Floor, San Francisco, California 94105."*
